rasterizer.layout: Pillow default BASIC for one codepoint

packing: LVGL 9 PLAIN (bitmap_format=0), 2bpp, high bits first, continuous rows, glyph starts byte-aligned, stride=0
coverage: All 7445 valid Python gb2312 double-byte mappings plus 95 printable ASCII characters. Exact Unicode inventory: coverage.txt. Not full Unicode/basic CJK, no emoji, no U+FFFD, no LVGL PUA icons.
unsupported_text: Keep LVGL placeholders enabled, or deliberately replace unsupported codepoints with supported '?' (U+003F) or square U+25A1 before display. Unknown characters are not silently mapped by this font.
metrics: 16px em; actual line_height=21 and base_line=5; max glyph box 17x18. Use line_height for UI layout.
runtime_memory: All arrays/descriptors and exported font are const Flash data. No constructor, heap allocation, full-font RAM load, compression buffer, filesystem, or PSRAM requirement. LVGL may use a per-glyph A8 draw buffer; max bounding area is at most 306 bytes before stride/alignment.
flash_estimate: 525658 bytes of bitmap/glyph/unicode tables with LV_FONT_FMT_TXT_LARGE=0, plus small cmap/font descriptor overhead. Exact linked size depends on target ABI/config; firmware owner must check map.
validation: python tools/agent_pet_font.py --check re-rasterizes, verifies source SHA256 and true source cmap glyph IDs, reproduces C byte-for-byte, parses emitted C and compares every glyph metric and pixel, checks all 7540 cmap lookups plus 5 missing-codepoint cases. Reviewed packing against official LVGL v9.5.0 fmt_txt reader. Device visual validation still required.

ui_subsets.coverage: Printable ASCII plus every non-ASCII character in main/main.c and main/agent_pet_text.c; exact list in coverage-ui.txt.
ui_subsets.use: Fixed UI copy only (titles, status, tabs, hints, large numbers). Dynamic task/inbox text must use pet_font_cjk_16.
ui_subsets.validation: python tools/agent_pet_font.py --check reproduces both subsets and their headers byte-for-byte; tests/test_agent_pet_text_coverage.py checks UI characters against coverage files without Pillow.
